en: Black‑and‑white street scene in a European city, showing a wide cobblestone avenue lined with tall late‑19th‑century buildings. The right side has shopfronts with signage, one reading "BILLARD-SALON." Farther down the street, elaborate historicist buildings with towers and spires frame the view. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the sidewalks and near a cart on the street, giving a bustling urban impression.
